name: @chuks/mobile
description: Chuks Mobile SDK: write your whole app in Chuks; it compiles to native and drives real iOS (SwiftUI + UIKit) and Android widgets through one engine. Ships the UI toolkit, navigation, theming, and native capabilities (permissions, file system, secure storage, audio, text-to-speech, local notifications, and battery / network / app-state streams).
author: Chuks Team
